lines: In this room where the sun fills the air
I wait softly for the moment
Before I know it I’m looking down from above, inside a box
There is no shared gaze
Soon my heart becomes a white, opaque thing
Even the light that fell on the snow scatters
Cold rain drips from the clouds
Only the distant spring breeze clears my eyes
Let the azalea bloom
To the warm garden
Take me out, take me out
Just kidding
There is no fairy tale that paints only happiness
I understand, I understand
Still
I want to go there
Without relying on anyone, the difficult equations
I solved them and uncovered the truth
Because I thought it was obvious
I never questioned anything
Now, even as the season tries to end
Only my own shadow follows
On the frozen road
I’ll cover it with a rain of flowers
So I won’t lose my way, properly
Teach me, okay
There is no crystal made solely of miracles
No perfect crystal exists
So, step by step
We’ll slowly walk hand in hand
The glass stuck to my chest melts and flows
A world overflowing with light
Soon
The small room I guarded alone
Has a little space left empty
I never knew it
It’s okay even if we’re together
The day I waited without understanding is over
Along with the thawing snow
It will turn into spring
Becoming clear water
And so
I’ll make the azalea bloom
After the long winter
Again and again, again and again
Inside this sun‑filled room
